The `SLTU` instruction performs the operation that compares the data in the general register `rj` with the data in the general register `rk` as unsigned integers. If the former is less than the latter, the value of the general register `rd` is set to `1` , otherwise it is set to `0` .

grades.quote: Even 32-bit unsigned integers extend bit 31 into bits 63 through 32. Consequently, conversion between unsigned and signed 32-bit integers is a no-op, as is conversion from a signed 32-bit integer to a signed 64-bit integer. Existing 64-bit wide SLTU and unsigned branch compares still operate correctly on unsigned 32-bit integers under this invariant.
